name: DEATHLOOP
notes: Void Engine DX12 → D3DMetal (Control class). Launch Deathloop.exe with SteamAppId=1252330. Ray tracing is DXR via D3DMetal on M3/M4; DLSS cannot run on Apple Silicon. Easy Anti-Cheat invasion multiplayer is not expected to work under Wine — single-player is the intended path. Pin CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
